summary: Re-test of iteration_15 fixes for Comparison feature. FIX 1 (backend period validation): POST /api/comparison/snapshot now returns 400 for period=yearly and 200 for weekly/monthly/quarterly; no invalid records leaked in any period list. FIX 2 (IRIS overlap): floating IRIS widget now collapsed to a bottom-right pill; real (non-force) click on history-delete-weekly-0 succeeded and removed the row. Full regression flow works: nav-comparison -> 3 tabs -> take 2 weekly snapshots -> compare-summary-weekly + compare-grid-weekly render with deltas, baseline badge shown on first snapshot, per-period isolation confirmed (monthly snapshot did NOT appear in weekly list). 9/9 backend pytest cases pass. All test-created snapshots cleaned up via API; tenant 'all' uploads preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: DELETE /api/comparison/snapshot/{id} still has no tenant/ownership check — any authenticated user can delete any snapshot. Non-blocking but should be addressed if multi-tenant scoping matters.

compare_snapshots always compares two latest records regardless of period semantics; label says 'weekly comparison' but delta reflects whatever cadence the user snapshots at. Consider surfacing this in copy.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All snapshots created during this test were deleted via API at end (verified 0 remaining across weekly/monthly/quarterly). Tenant 'all' rules/xsoar/logval data untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Comparison feature fully green. Both iteration_15 fixes verified: (1) 400 on invalid period, (2) pb-28 on ComparisonDashboard means IRIS floating widget no longer overlaps snapshot history delete icons. Only remaining code-review notes are: no ownership check on DELETE snapshot, and compare label vs actual snapshot cadence.
